lines.text: God gave up His own Son for us all, so He will freely give us all things.
Christ Jesus, who died and was raised, is at the right hand of God interceding for us.
Trouble, distress, persecution, plague, nakedness, danger and sword are named as things that might separate us from Christ's love.
Scripture says we face death all day long and are considered as goats to be slaughtered.
We are more than conquerors through Him, and nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love.
